# S6 frozen heuristic experiment

S6 adds a one-point parent TT depth penalty only after a valid child score fails the existing beta-side agreement test, and only when the parent snapshot bound is not BOUND_EXACT. The candidate starts directly from effdc3f. The invalid-child and matching-side early returns remain unchanged. All existing non-PV, excluded-move, parent validity/depth/bound/window, rule50 <96, depth >=7, move legality and nondecisive-parent gates remain. There is no penalty on high-rule50 fallthrough and no child value conversion, occupancy filter, bound reinterpretation, or exact-key shortcut.

This is a heuristic strength experiment, not a correctness fix or claimed gainer. The fresh baseline-only diagnostic established actual retention at the save gate: 483 unchanged contradictory returns reached a final save, all rejected. It also observed 263 later stable vetoes and 202 later allowed reuses, so deletion/aging may discard useful deeper information. The selected magnitude reuses existing Case B penalize(1); it is not estimated from these observations. Protecting exact parent entries follows the current secondary-aging exclusion of exact entries. No per-position condition or alternative magnitude will be tried on this corpus.

Credit and distinctions: Daniel Monroe introduced the empirical child verification in #6069 and simplified child-score handling in #6094. Dubslow's #6819, with Xu-Shawn's investigation, introduced the existing parent bound/window mismatch penalty. Xu-Shawn's #6480 removal of broad aging and #6818 restricted decisive secondary aging demonstrate the scaling risk. S6 applies after a different trigger: the actual child veto inside Case A. It leaves the existing Case B and save-time secondary aging untouched. The exact-entry protection is borrowed as a conservative policy, not a proof of safety. Relevant prior issue #6742 supplied stale deep-entry traces; the new diagnostic independently measured the actual save predicate and subsequent reuse.

Risks include reduced reuse of useful deeper bounds, selective-search/window/history differences masquerading as contradiction, double exposure to existing future aging, SMP snapshots changing between probe and penalize, and long-time-control scaling loss. Production TT fields are individually RelaxedAtomic and the record snapshot is nontransactional; no C++ ordinary-field data-race assertion is made. penalize acts on the writer's slot, as the existing Case B does. The parent-bound guard protects the observed snapshot, not a transactionally locked current entry under SMP.

Root owns the held-out tactical/game protocol. Candidate source, rationale and patch are frozen before builds/searches. No search is permitted until that protocol is ready and root releases compute. Native validation will use real Windows/MSVC and Linux release execution, baseline/candidate exact hashes, default bench, the existing 75-test suite and the existing 180-scenario legal bestmove/PV smoke test. These runtime checks do not establish strength. Artifacts will contain text/source/results only with 7-day retention.
